# Unknown Proxies

Unknown Proxies provides premium residential and ISP proxies for retail shopping automation, ticket brokers, social media account management, and enterprise data aggregators. Trusted by over 250,000 customers since 2019, Unknown Proxies delivers 99.9% proxy uptime and same-hour customer support responses 16+ hours/day. Unknown Proxies delivers enterprise-grade performance with boutique-level support, ensuring that customers remain unblocked from almost all websites and bypassing artificial limits imposed by websites.

> Unknown Proxies Reserve Residential infrastructure has tens of millions of residential IPs across 100+ different countries. The Reserve Residential network supports both static and rotating residential proxies, up to 120 minute session times, and user:pass proxy authentication. 
Residential proxies are best used for sensitive, highly-protected websites. Given they're billed per GB sent and received, residential proxies are not cost-efficient for high-bandwidth use-cases. Unknown Proxies recommends ISP proxies for the following use cases:
- Account Creation: Creating multiple accounts on highly-protected websites
- Web Scraping: Gathering data 
- Event Tickets: 
- Retail Purchases: 

> Unknown Proxies' ISP network runs on a 100GBPS backbone and provides unlimited bandwidth ISP proxies in 11 locations around the world including North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific regions. ISP proxies can be delivered in both HTTP(S) and SOCKS(5) protocols.
Given the low-latency and unlimited bandwidth nature of ISP proxies, Unknown Proxies recommends ISP proxies for the following use cases:
- Monitoring: Frequently checking for changes on websites
 - Examples: Monitoring item prices on retail websites for arbitrage opportunities, monitoring point redemptions on airline websites, monitoring ticket prices on ticketing websites for arbitrage opportunities
- Web Scraping: Gathering data from low-security websites or downloading high-bandwidth files from websites (images, videos, etc.)
 - Examples: Downloading videos from YouTube to train an AI model
- Account Management: Organizing mass login or payment credentials for websites 
 - Examples: Using software to login to and read emails from multiple accounts
- Event Tickets: Applications that assist ticket brokers to purchase high-demand tickets to concerts or sporting events
 - Examples: Purchasing sports and concert tickets from TicketMaster.com, SeatGeek.com, StubHub.com, VividSeats.com, Paciolan (evenue.net), and more
- Retail Purchases: Applications that assist users to purchase high-demand goods from websites like Target.com, Walmart.com, Amazon.com, Nike.com, Bestbuy.com, Costco.com, and many more. See our sitelist for the latest product recommendations by website.
 - Examples: Purchasing high-demand trading cards from Walmart.com or Topps.com
